# PyPI advisory IDs consciously waived. One per line, each with a triage note and the
# release that FIXES it as `fixed=<version>` inside the comment.
#
# The `fixed=` marker is not decoration: tools/check_crypto_surface.py compares it against the
# `cryptography==` pin in engine/requirements-ci.txt and goes RED when a pin has outgrown a
# waiver, so a line here cannot outlive the vulnerability it waives. It lives inside the `#`
# comment because the workflow reads this file with `id="${line%%#*}"` and then strips all
# whitespace — anything outside the comment would be glued onto the advisory id and handed to
# pip-audit as garbage.
#
# WHY THESE ARE WAIVED. The signing surface of this repository is Ed25519 with raw key bytes:
# Ed25519PrivateKey.generate / from_private_bytes, Ed25519PublicKey.from_public_bytes, .sign,
# .verify, and serialization.Encoding.Raw with NoEncryption. Measured 2026-09-19: zero x509 /
# pkcs7 / pkcs12 / cms / ocsp imports and zero load_pem_* / load_der_* / load_ssh_* calls
# anywhere in the tree. Every advisory below is reached only through one of those surfaces.
# That premise is no longer prose — tools/check_crypto_surface.py enforces it, and the day
# somebody writes load_pem_private_key the gate goes RED and names this file.
#
# cryptography 49.0.0 and 50.0.0 were both tried; the bump broke the engine's governance
# runtime, so the four advisories that need them are waived rather than forced. Note what that
# reason does NOT cover: three further advisories (PYSEC-2026-2141 = GHSA-r6ph-v2qm-q3c2 HIGH,
# PYSEC-2026-35, PYSEC-2026-36) were waived here under the same sentence while being fixed in
# 46.0.5, 46.0.6 and 46.0.7 — patch releases inside the pinned 46.0 line. The pin moved
# 46.0.3 -> 46.0.7 and those three lines are deleted. Rule 2 of the gate exists so that a
# waiver cannot again borrow a neighbour's excuse.

# Bundled OpenSSL in the cryptography wheels (18 CVEs, advisory of 2026-06-09). The HIGH one
# is CVE-2026-45447, a use-after-free in OpenSSL's PKCS7_verify(); the rest are CMS, OCSP,
# QUIC, CMP, FFC-DH, AES-OCB/SIV and ASN.1-parsing paths. None is reachable from Ed25519 raw
# sign/verify, which touches no ASN.1 parser and no protocol stack. CVSS says availability
# only (C:N/I:N/A:H):
GHSA-537c-gmf6-5ccf  # fixed=48.0.1 — bundled OpenSSL; PKCS#7/CMS/QUIC/ASN.1 surfaces, all unused
# X.509 verifier accepts wildcard DNS names, escaping permittedSubtrees (X.509 path validation
# — this repository runs no path validation):
GHSA-m2h6-j472-rp4c  # fixed=49.0.0 — X.509 path validation, unused
# PKCS#7 EnvelopedData decryption exposes a Bleichenbacher oracle (PKCS#7 — unused):
GHSA-g6cj-pr64-35w5  # fixed=50.0.0 — PKCS#7 EnvelopedData decryption, unused
# Duplicate self-signed intermediates cause exponential path building (X.509 — unused):
GHSA-jwv3-5hgf-82ww  # fixed=49.0.0 — X.509 path building, unused
